scope: Synthetic task narratives authored and frozen before this matcher revision. The challenge labels are agent judgements, not independent career advice or a participant study. Its first post-change evaluation is retained even when a label misses; later tuning must not call this an untouched holdout.
methodology: No challenge predictions were inspected before editing this matcher. Baseline and first candidate results are evaluated together after the candidate implementation is frozen. Old golden/adversarial cases are observed regressions, not untouched holdouts.
